hero.badge: English Teacher in Ho Chi Minh City
hero.title: Speak English with Confidence and Joy
hero.subtitle: Hi, I'm Teacher Bek. I help students in Ho Chi Minh City move past the fear of making mistakes and start actually speaking. Whether you're 5 or 50, let's find your voice together.

about.label: Hello
about.title: A Teacher Who Listens
about.intro: I believe the best way to learn is by doing - speaking, laughing, and trying without fear.

story.title: My Approach
story.p1: I am a fully qualified teacher (TESOL & PGCE) with a passion for checking in with my students. I don't just teach from a textbook; I look at how you learn best.
story.p2: I've taught everywhere from big international schools like ILA to local kindergartens. I've seen that everyone learns differently, and that's okay.
story.p3: Now, I run my own classroom in Phú Nhuận. It's a space designed for you to feel comfortable, because when you're relaxed, you learn faster.

classroom.title: The Classroom
classroom.description: A safe, quiet space where you can focus.
classroom.address: Golden Mansion 1, 119 Phổ Quang, Phú Nhuận

philosophy.title: Why It Works
philosophy.description: My classes are not about memorizing lists of words. They are about using English to connect with people. We play games, we have conversations, and we build your confidence step by step.

courses.title: How We'll Learn Together
courses.subtitle: Every student is different. Here's how I adapt my teaching to meet you where you are.

beginner.title: First Steps
beginner.description: For young learners and complete beginners. We build confidence through games, songs, and lots of patience. No pressure, just progress.

intermediate.title: Finding Your Voice
intermediate.description: You know some English but want to speak more naturally. We'll focus on real conversations, everyday situations, and building fluency.

advanced.title: Polish & Confidence
advanced.description: For students preparing for exams, interviews, or just wanting to master the language. We refine pronunciation, expand vocabulary, and tackle complex topics.

business.title: Young Learners
business.description: Specialized classes for children aged 4-12. I've taught at kindergartens and primary schools across HCMC - I know how to make learning fun.

testimonials.title: Community Feedback
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from students, parents, and colleagues

cta.title: Curious about classes?
cta.subtitle: No pressure, no commitments. Let's just have a conversation about your goals.

faq.title: Common Questions
faq.a1: I teach at my dedicated classroom in Golden Mansion 1, 119 Phổ Quang, Phú Nhuận. It's a comfortable, properly designed space with CCTV for safety. I can also come to your location in Phú Nhuận, Gò Vấp, or Bình Thạnh.
faq.a2: Everyone! I've taught kindergarteners, primary school students, teenagers, and adults. With nearly 2,000 students taught across 3 years, I've learned to adapt my methods for each age group.
faq.a3: It depends on the type of class, location, and frequency. Let's chat about your needs first, and I'll give you a clear quote with no hidden fees.
faq.a4: Yes! Group classes can be more affordable and often more fun. If you have friends or family who want to learn together, we can arrange something at my classroom.
faq.a5: I hold TESOL and PGCE certifications, and I'm currently pursuing my DELTA. I've taught at ILA Vietnam, Blue Sky Academy, and over 15 schools across Ho Chi Minh City.
faq.q6: Can I try a lesson first?
faq.a6: Of course! We can do a short trial session at my classroom so you can see if we're a good fit. No obligation.
